description: This is a unit test class for the Relationships module in SuiteCRM, utilizing PHPUnit. It tests various functionalities such as relationship existence, retrieval, deletion, and module associations.

classes.name: RelationshipTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing Relationship functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testRelationship
methods.description: Tests the creation of a Relationship object and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testis_self_referencing
methods.description: Checks whether a relationship is self-referencing based on table and key attributes.

methods.name: testexists
methods.description: Verifies the existence check method for relationships with valid and invalid names.

methods.name: testdelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testget_other_module
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the other module in a relationship.

methods.name: testRetrieveBySides
methods.description: Tests retrieval of relationship details given module sides.

methods.name: testRetrieveByModules
methods.description: Tests retrieval of relationship details given module names and relationship type.

methods.name: testretrieve_by_name
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of relationship by name, verifying properties.

methods.name: testload_relationship_meta
methods.description: Tests loading of relationship metadata into global context.

methods.name: testbuild_relationship_cache
methods.description: Verifies building of the relationship cache without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: testcache_file_dir
methods.description: Checks the cache file directory path.

methods.name: testdelete_cache
methods.description: Ensures cache deletion executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testtrace_relationship_module
methods.description: Tests tracing a relationship to find the related user module.
